text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My dorm held a pillow fight tournament last night…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I conked out at some point. When I woke up, I was back in my room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wonder which team won in the end?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I think I'll ask the others for the deets. I should prolly ask when the next one is, too, while I'm at it… Yaaawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer looks both excited and sleepy at the same time.
